messages:
samir-sales: Quick heads-up — Acme Health RFP scorecard due EOD Fri. Need final technical appendix + capability scorecard + pricing matrix. I uploaded v0 here: https://drive.redwood/acme-acq/v0 (please don't edit raw; I'll collate).

maria-td: I'll take the technical appendix (model support, quantization, latency SLOs, function calling notes). Will separate Hosted / Dedicated / Private rows.

june-ops: I'll own deployment & networking (VPC, peering, subnet ranges, egress). Liam, need GPU SKU throughput and example capacity planning.

liam-eng: On it. Can we standardize throughput units as tokens/s at seq=512 and batch=32? Adding quick perf table to the doc:  
```
GPU      seq512_tps   batch_size  notes
A100-40  4200         32          int8 quantized
H100     6700         32          fp16 baseline
```
liam-eng: Also proposing POC acceptance: single-stream 95th pct latency < 300ms for 2k token gen, and sustained 90k tokens/min for throughput benchmark.

eva-security: I'll review SSQ and Data Residency. Question: do they require HSM attestation, or is customer-managed KMS sufficient? @samir-sales they marked HSM preferred in the RFP text.

samir-sales: HSM preferred but they said KMS acceptable with attestation + SOC2 evidence. Put both options and a delta in pricing. Also note we don't hold FedRAMP for Redwood Private yet — call that out.

review-bot: Attached: acme_ssq_answers_v1.pdf (uploaded to the thread).

maria-td: Drafting capability scorecard now. Columns: model-family coverage, latency SLO, throughput, cost-efficiency, privacy/isolation, rollout controls. Scoring 1-5. Will flag items needing product input.

june-ops: Timeline check — can we turn around a consolidated ZIP for AE by Thursday EOD to give Legal time Friday?

liam-eng: Thursday EOD doable. I'll drop perf artifacts + kernel/quant notes by 11:30am PT tomorrow.

eva-security: I'll finish SSQ review by 6pm Thu. If they insist on HSM, note expected lead time for onboarding + contract addendum.

samir-sales: Who owns Dedicated pricing rows (reserved capacity tiers, burst rates, SLA)?

maria-td: I'll sketch baseline pricing: M (reserved 2x GPUs), L (reserved 8x GPUs), XL (dedicated cluster). June, can you add ops uplift (network egress, support retainer)?

june-ops: Adding ops uplift per region and an item for private deployment setup. Also adding recommended autoscale policy for POC (min 1, max 4 nodes).

liam-eng: Small perf caveat to include: sequence lengths >1024 start to show higher memory pressure; recommend truncation or KV cache tuning for chat-like load.

eva-security: Also adding KMS/HSM integration notes: we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM via partner HSM-bridge (requires contract). Put a short matrix.

samir-sales: Great. Two small asks before I collate: 1) mark any public benchmarks with source links; 2) add a "known gaps" section (e.g., no FedRAMP, limited APAC on-prem partners). Please prefix known gaps with [GAP]. :thumbsup:

maria-td: Done — added links to internal bench page and a short "developer notes" subsection.

june-ops: Uploaded an ops-cost worksheet (CSV) to the drive. Link in doc.

liam-eng: Pushed perf figures and a small script snippet for running token throughput locally: 
```bash
python perf/run_bench.py --model gpt-open-8b --seq 512 --batch 32 --duration 60
```

eva-security: SSQ final comments added. Flagged three questions for legal around data processing addendum.

samir-sales: Thank you all. I'll compile into acme_rfp_final.zip and share to AE + legal. If anything critical changes, ping this thread.

maria-td: One last note — for capability scoring I put "4" on private deploy because we support it, but noted integration extras (networking, KMS).

june-ops: Confirmed. I'll include region-specific IP ranges and peering checklist in the appendix.

liam-eng: Uploaded microbench logs to the drive folder.

review-bot: Final package assembled: acme_rfp_final_v1.zip (includes SSQ, capability_scorecard.xlsx, perf_artifacts.tar.gz).

samir-sales: Awesome. Sending to AE now. Thanks team.
